summary.en: A lever lock keyed from both sides, with no cylinder at all: the key moves the levers directly through a keyhole in the faceplate. BS 3621 certification requires at least five levers, hardplates and a 20 mm bolt throw. Retrofit is hard here — there is no cylinder and no spindle to drive.
summary.zh: 双面钥匙的拨杆锁，完全没有锁芯：钥匙直接穿过面板上的钥匙孔拨动杠杆。BS 3621 认证要求至少五片杠杆、防钻硬板与 20 mm 方舌行程。这类锁改造最难——既没有锁芯，也没有方轴可驱动。

en: Lever stack — the gate pattern that gives the key its differs
Faceplate with a keyhole on each side
Kitemark stamp on the faceplate when certified
zh: 杠杆组：形成钥匙差异的槽口排列
只有方舌，没有弹簧斜舌
面板两侧各有一个钥匙孔
通过认证时面板上有 Kitemark 印记

typical.en: Case sizes commonly 76 mm or 64 mm (3 in / 2.5 in nominal)
typical.zh: 锁体常见 76 mm 或 64 mm（标称 3 英寸 / 2.5 英寸）

how.en: Measure the case width across the door edge.

typical.en: 44 mm (76 mm case) or 57 mm, varies by maker
typical.zh: 44 mm（76 mm 锁体）或 57 mm，因厂商而异

how.en: Door edge to the centre of the keyhole.

typical.en: 5 for BS 3621; 2 or 3 on older and interior locks
typical.zh: BS 3621 要求 5 片；旧锁与室内锁为 2 或 3 片

how.en: Count through the keyhole or from the case edge.
how.zh: 从钥匙孔或锁体侧面数。

how.en: Key the bolt fully out and measure how far it projects past the faceplate.
how.zh: 把方舌完全旋出，量它突出面板的距离。

notes.en: There is no clean retrofit for a lever lock. The honest options are: (1) replace the case with a euro-cylinder mortise deadlock, which needs a new door prep and, on a fire door, a certified doorset; (2) keep the lever lock and add a separate smart deadbolt above or below; (3) leave it alone — a BS 3621 lever lock is already a good lock. Never design a retrofit that leaves the door unable to be opened by hand from inside.
notes.zh: 拨杆锁没有干净的改造方案。诚实的选项是：（1）把锁体换成欧标锁芯插芯死锁，这需要重新开孔，防火门上还需整套门组认证；（2）保留原锁，在其上方或下方另加一把智能插销；（3）不改——BS 3621 拨杆锁本身已是好锁。绝不要设计出内侧无法徒手开启的改造方案。

en.q: How do I know if my lock is really BS 3621?
en.a: Look for the Kitemark and the words BS 3621 stamped on the faceplate — the strip visible on the door edge when the door is open. Some 5-lever locks are not certified, and a 3-lever lock can never be.

en.q: What is the difference between BS 3621 and BS 8621?
en.a: Same attack resistance. BS 3621 needs a key on both sides; BS 8621 has a thumb-turn or push-pad inside for keyless escape. BS 10621 locks from outside only.

zh.q: 怎么确认我的锁真的是 BS 3621？
zh.a: 看面板（开门时门边可见的金属条）上是否有 Kitemark 印记与 BS 3621 字样。部分五杆锁并未认证，而三杆锁永远不可能通过。

zh.q: BS 3621 与 BS 8621 有什么区别？
zh.a: 抗攻击能力相同。BS 3621 两面都要钥匙；BS 8621 内侧带旋钮或按钮，可免钥匙逃生；BS 10621 只能从外侧上锁。
